fakes.lsof:
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$FAKE_LOG_DIR/lsof.log"
port=""
for a in "$@"; do
  case "$a" in
    -iTCP:*) port="${a#-iTCP:}" ;;
  esac
done
f="$FAKE_LSOF_DIR/$port"
n=0
if [ -f "$f" ]; then
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    case "$line" in
      ''|*[!0-9]*) printf '%s\n' "$line"; n=$((n+1)) ;;
      *) if kill -0 "$line" 2>/dev/null; then printf '%s\n' "$line"; n=$((n+1)); fi ;;
    esac
  done < "$f"
fi
if [ -f "$f.exit" ]; then
  read code < "$f.exit"
  exit "$code"
fi
[ "$n" -gt 0 ] || exit 1
exit 0
